transloadit-skills-admin-merge.description: Update a GitHub PR with latest main, resolve conflicts, follow CI with gh-run-watch.ts, fix related failures, and squash merge with --admin. Use when asked to admin-merge a PR; escalate if completion is unsuccessful. Reviewing whether a PR is needed or creating this skill does not invoke the merge workflow.

transloadit-skills-docs-transloadit-robo.description: Offline lookup for Transloadit Robots and their parameter docs/examples via the `transloadit` CLI. Use to draft or validate `steps` JSON without guessing robot names/params.

transloadit-skills-integrate-asset-deliv.description: Add server-side Transloadit Smart CDN URL signing for an explicitly configured asset to a Next.js App Router project.

transloadit-skills-integrate-uppy-transl.description: Add Uppy Dashboard + Transloadit uploads to a Next.js (App Router) app, with server-side signature generation and optional /s3/store export.

transloadit-skills-transform-build-mosai.description: One-off justified mosaic photo collage (N local images -> single image) using the official `@transloadit/node` CLI. Uses the `/image/merge` Robot's `mosaic` effect to build a justified tiled layout with center-cropped photos, and downloads the result to an explicit output path via `--output`.

transloadit-skills-transform-build-polar.description: One-off polaroid-stack photo collage (N local images -> single image) using the official `@transloadit/node` CLI. Uses the `/image/merge` Robot's `polaroid-stack` effect and downloads the result to an explicit output path via `--output`.

transloadit-skills-transform-caption-vid.description: Add plain burned captions to a local video and download the captioned video plus SRT cues using the caption-video Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-capture-web.description: Capture a public webpage or local HTML as an image or PDF using the capture-webpage Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-convert-mar.description: Convert a local Office document, HTML, Markdown or text file to PDF using the convert-to-pdf Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI. Includes the existing Markdown-to-PDF workflow.

transloadit-skills-transform-describe-im.description: One-off image description using the official `@transloadit/node` CLI. Use `image describe --fields labels` for object-style labels, or `image describe --for wordpress` for structured alt text, title, caption, and description JSON.

transloadit-skills-transform-encode-hls-.description: One-off HLS encoding (local video -> HLS renditions + playlist) using Transloadit via the `transloadit` CLI. Prefer builtin templates (`builtin/encode-hls-video@latest`) and download outputs locally via `-o`.

transloadit-skills-transform-encode-vide.description: Encode a local video for web playback as MP4 or WebM using the encode-video Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-extract-tex.description: Extract readable text or JSON from local PDFs, scans, photos and Office documents using the extract-text Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-generate-im.description: One-off image generation (prompt -> image file) using Transloadit via the `transloadit` CLI. Prefer `image generate` for text-only and input-guided generation, and use `--output` when you need a deterministic path.

transloadit-skills-transform-make-video-.description: Make cover images from a local video, using regular frames, exact offsets or smart selection through the video-covers Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-prepare-ima.description: Prepare local images for a website with orientation correction, resizing, compression and format conversion using the prepare-image Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-remove-back.description: Remove a local photo's background and download a transparent PNG using the remove-background Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-transcribe-.description: Transcribe local audio or video to text, timestamped JSON, SRT or WebVTT using the transcribe Builtin and the official Transloadit CLI.

transloadit-skills-transform-upscale-ima.description: One-off AI image upscaling (local image -> upscaled image) using Transloadit via the `transloadit` CLI. Prefer the `image upscale` intent and use `--output` for a deterministic path.

transloadit-skills-transloadit.description: Main entry-point skill for Transloadit. Route to the right `integrate-*`, `transform-*`, or `docs-*` skill, and prefer executing via `npx -y @transloadit/node ...` (CLI) for deterministic behavior.
